data.title: Socratic Prompting Foundations, CRIT Algorithm & The Socratic Method Taxonomy
data.description: Comprehensive architectural reference on Edward Y. Chang's Socratic Prompting taxonomy (Type 2 Focused vs. Type 3 Exploratory questioning), the CRIT (Critical Reading Inquisitive Template) mathematical verification algorithm, abductive error mitigation over Chain-of-Thought, psychological safety asymmetry, and Google Cloud ADK 2.0 multi-agent implementation.
